newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 17.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Mainstream right-wing RPR party reaffirms committment to fighting left-wing and extreme-right parties with equal strength.
-- Some 70,000 people demonstrated in Brussels on Sunday for jobs and against planned shut-down of a Renault assembly plant in Belgium.
-- Government by decree calls on French pharmaceutical sector to develop generic drugs, which make up only three percent of drugs prescribed in France.
